parts.question: What was the renal starting dose for moderate impairment in Germany?

result.answer: For moderate renal impairment in Germany, the historical starting dose for AX-17 was 50 mg once daily (OD) [E1, E2]. This information is from a superseded regulatory label that was in effect from 2025-02-03 to 2026-09-15 [E1, E2].
